function ssrRender(_ctx, _push, _parent, _attrs) {
  _push(_ssrRenderComponent(_resolveComponent("Outer"), _attrs, {
    default: _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
      if (_push) {
        _push(_ssrRenderComponent(_resolveComponent("Comp"), null, _createSlots({
          "item.alpha": _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
            if (_push) {
              _push(`x`)
            } else {
              return [_createTextVNode("x")]
            }
          }),
          _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
        }, [
          (_ctx.ok) ? {
            name: "a.b",
            fn: _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
              if (_push) {
                _push(`y`)
              } else {
                return [_createTextVNode("y")]
              }
            }),
            key: "0"
          } : undefined
        ]), _parent, _scopeId))
      } else {
        return [_createVNode(_resolveComponent("Comp"), null, _createSlots({ "item.alpha": _withCtx((_) => [_createTextVNode("x")]), _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */ }, [(_ctx.ok) ? { name: "a.b", fn: _withCtx((_) => [_createTextVNode("y")]), key: "0" } : undefined]))]
      }
    }),
    _: 1
  }, _parent))
}
